elo_report_total_bate.name: elo_report_total_bate
elo_report_total_bate.value:
total_present IS NULL OR total_present =
          COALESCE(members_present, 0) + COALESCE(visitors_present, 0)
          + COALESCE(children_present, 0)

elo_report_cancelamento_tem_motivo.name: elo_report_cancelamento_tem_motivo
elo_report_cancelamento_tem_motivo.value: happened OR (cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancellation_reason)) > 0)

weekly_study_agendado_tem_data.name: weekly_study_agendado_tem_data
weekly_study_agendado_tem_data.value: status <> 'agendado' OR publish_at IS NOT NULL

weekly_study_publicado_tem_data.name: weekly_study_publicado_tem_data
weekly_study_publicado_tem_data.value: status <> 'publicado' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

weekly_study_periodo_coerente.name: weekly_study_periodo_coerente
weekly_study_periodo_coerente.value: usable_from IS NULL OR usable_until IS NULL OR usable_from <= usable_until
